description.en: Ontology module for representing concrete observations, declarations and settings about textile use, care, environmental exposure, storage and user behaviour. Context factor types are represented as SKOS concepts; processes and process parameters remain in TEXTILE_PROCESS.

comments.en: A context observation is not a textile process, process parameter, assessment result or derived indicator. Washing temperature and similar operational settings remain represented through TEXTILE_PROCESS.
